note: MADE-UP sample for the tests and the demo: one stage in the compact single-stage form of the curriculum files (CURRICULUM_FORMAT.md §3). stage holds the stage's own fields; the top level holds its skills, greetingActivityIds, topics, lessonTemplates and trackerRows beside activities, equipment and safety. Every name and sentence is invented; none of it is YMCA text.

activities.name: Rainbow Treasure Hunt
activities.description: A helper points to a spot on the bottom near the steps. Swimmers take one breath, look under at it, and come back up to say what they saw.

activities.name: Moonbeam Hide and Seek
activities.description: Everyone joins the moonbeam crew: take one breath, put your face in, blow bubbles for a count of three, then come up and wave. Bring small toys.

activities.name: Manatee Bubble Party
activities.description: A helper points to a spot on the bottom near the steps. Swimmers take one breath, look under at it, and come back up to say what they saw.

activities.name: Manatee Glide
activities.description: Swimmers push off like a manatee leaving the dock and glide with arms stretched out toward a helper or the wall.

activities.name: Dragon Launch
activities.description: A helper holds out their hands as a finish line. Swimmers glide toward them and try to reach them before they stand.

activities.name: Meteor Torpedo
activities.description: Swimmers push off like a meteor leaving the dock and glide with arms stretched out toward a helper or the wall. Bring small toys.

activities.name: Kangaroo Step Out
activities.description: Play Kangaroo Island: the deck is the island, and swimmers climb out to reach it and take a seat.

activities.name: Sunflower Home Base
activities.description: Hands on the edge, pull up, bring one knee onto the deck and stand. Everyone takes a turn while the group cheers. Bring small toys.

activities.name: Iceberg Climb
activities.description: Play Iceberg Island: the deck is the island, and swimmers climb out to reach it and take a seat.

activities.name: Otter Home Base
activities.description: Swimmers climb out at the wall like an otter coming ashore, then walk back to the steps. Bring a hoop.

activities.name: Beaver Climb
activities.description: Hands on the edge, pull up, bring one knee onto the deck and stand. Everyone takes a turn while the group cheers.

activities.name: Lantern Jump
activities.description: Put a lantern sticker on the wall. After each jump, swimmers turn around and touch it.

activities.name: Pancake Float
activities.description: Swimmers float like a sleepy pancake, arms and legs spread wide, while a helper counts slowly to ten. Bring a pool noodle or a rescue tube.

activities.name: Popcorn Drift
activities.description: Call out a shape; swimmers make it while floating, then stand up with control. Bring small toys.

activities.name: Pirate Drift
activities.description: Call out a shape; swimmers make it while floating, then stand up with control.

activities.name: Dragon Roll
activities.description: Swimmers start on their front and roll onto their back like a dragon turning over, then rest face up. Bring a pool noodle.

activities.name: Narwhal Journey
activities.description: Go on a narwhal voyage: swim, rest, swim again, and tell the group where you went.

activities.name: Meteor Flip
activities.description: When the instructor claps, swimmers roll from back to front, then back again. Bring a hoop.

activities.name: Koala Snooze
activities.description: Swimmers float like a sleepy koala, arms and legs spread wide, while a helper counts slowly to ten.

activities.name: Flamingo Nap
activities.description: The water is a giant flamingo bed: swimmers lie back, relax their shoulders and listen for the signal to stand.

activities.name: Pelican Snooze
activities.description: Swimmers float like a sleepy pelican, arms and legs spread wide, while a helper counts slowly to ten.

activities.name: Lobster Slide
activities.description: Line up at the wall. At the count of three, each swimmer pushes and glides as far as they can, then stands up with control.

activities.name: Pancake Rocket Ride
activities.description: A helper holds out their hands as a finish line. Swimmers glide toward them and try to reach them before they stand.

activities.name: Koala Launch
activities.description: A helper holds out their hands as a finish line. Swimmers glide toward them and try to reach them before they stand.

activities.name: Iceberg Bob
activities.description: Swimmers keep their heads up like an iceberg on lookout, moving arms and legs to stay in place. Bring a life jacket or a float belt.

activities.name: Heron Lookout
activities.description: Play Heron Periscope: tread water, look around, and name something you can see on the deck. Bring a rescue tube or a pool noodle.

activities.name: Submarine Periscope
activities.description: Swimmers pedal their legs slowly and sweep their hands while the group counts to ten.

activities.name: Canoe Trip
activities.description: Swimmers move forward a short way, turn onto their back to rest like a canoe, then roll over and keep going. Bring a hoop.

activities.name: Tugboat Swim
activities.description: Go on a tugboat voyage: swim, rest, swim again, and tell the group where you went.

activities.name: Iceberg Trip
activities.description: Go on a iceberg voyage: swim, rest, swim again, and tell the group where you went.

activities.name: Tugboat Hello
activities.description: Swimmers sit on the edge and say their name and their favourite tugboat.

activities.name: Thunder Handshake
activities.description: Give each swimmer a thunder nickname for today and use it all lesson.

activities.name: Castle Hello
activities.description: Swimmers sit on the edge and say their name and their favourite castle.

activities.name: Snowflake Welcome
activities.description: Go around the circle; each swimmer says hello and shares one thing about their day.

activities.name: Sunflower Name Circle
activities.description: Give each swimmer a sunflower nickname for today and use it all lesson.

activities.name: Pinwheel Welcome
activities.description: Go around the circle; each swimmer says hello and shares one thing about their day.

activities.name: Heron Roll Call
activities.description: Go around the circle; each swimmer says hello and shares one thing about their day. Bring a ball.

activities.name: Submarine Handshake
activities.description: Give each swimmer a submarine nickname for today and use it all lesson.

activities.name: Puffin Name Circle
activities.description: Give each swimmer a puffin nickname for today and use it all lesson.

activities.name: Rocket Wave
activities.description: Swimmers sit on the edge and say their name and their favourite rocket.

activities.name: Jellybean Roll Call
activities.description: Go around the circle; each swimmer says hello and shares one thing about their day.

activities.name: Dragon Handshake
activities.description: Give each swimmer a dragon nickname for today and use it all lesson.

activities.name: Meteor Hello

safety.text: One breath at a time: swimmers take a single normal breath before each time they go under, never several deep breaths in a row.
